title: Auxiliary Verbs Overview
subtitle: DO/HAVE/BE и их роли в грамматике

ruleBlocks.text: В английском auxiliary - это не просто дополнительный элемент, а каркас грамматики. Он показывает время, тип вопроса/отрицания, залог и согласование. Если правильно выбрать auxiliary, структура предложения обычно уже наполовину решена.

ruleBlocks.caption: Кто за что отвечает
rows: вопросы и отрицания в Simple (без be)
Если это Simple и нет be/modal -> почти всегда do-family
путаница have как auxiliary и have как смысловой глагол
Если есть V3 и результат/опыт к моменту -> have-family
Если есть V-ing или be + V3 -> нужен be-family
после modal/will в Passive -> be; в perfect-continuous встречается been

ruleBlocks.caption: DO - DOES - DID
rows: How DO you get to school? / Helga DOES not drink coffee in the morning, DOES she? / I DID not make any mistakes in the test. / DID you use to go to the gym regularly?

ruleBlocks.caption: HAVE - HAS - HAD
rows: HAVE you ever been to China? / He HAS been living in Minsk for many years, HASN'T he?
I HAD read the book before I watched the film adaptation.

ruleBlocks.caption: AM - IS - ARE; WAS - WERE
rows: We ARE best friends. / The damage WAS not serious, WAS it?
He IS learning to ride a bike, ISN'T he? / We WERE waiting for the test results.
Present Simple Passive / Past Simple Passive
The rubbish IS collected twice a week, ISN'T it? / The messages WERE not delivered, WERE they?

ruleBlocks.caption: BE / BEEN
rows: I will BE ready in 5 minutes. / The painting will BE sold at auction next week. / Homework must BE handed in tomorrow morning.
It has BEEN raining since morning.
